note: Routing-miss lessons. Only cross-contest failure patterns may be promoted to the Universal rule set (scope=UNIVERSAL); contest-specific experience stays PROJECT_SPECIFIC and may only feed a PROJECT_ROUTING_EXTENSION. Entries are abstract patterns, never contest answers (spec 35/36).

entries.failure_pattern: same-timestamp event ordering assumed instead of defined
entries.new_general_rule: undefined simultaneous-event ordering is an algorithmic-semantics risk -> YELLOW

entries.failure_pattern: sampling unit / split scheme assumed (row vs subject, random vs temporal)
entries.new_general_rule: any sampling-unit or train/test split choice not frozen by authority is a statistical-inference risk -> YELLOW

entries.failure_pattern: prior draw used where a conditional posterior draw was required
entries.new_general_rule: prior-vs-conditional probability semantics: when the conditioning state exists, the draw must be conditional; any ambiguity is a statistical risk

entries.failure_pattern: residual-vs-absolute time/age coordinate mismatch between two modules
entries.new_general_rule: coordinate-system mismatches across modules are a numerical-method risk; a unit/coordinate consistency check belongs in the verification plan

entries.failure_pattern: claimed test coverage was not actually exercised by the executed checker
entries.new_general_rule: claimed coverage that is not exercised is a validation-interpretation risk (S5) -> YELLOW under formal scope

entries.failure_pattern: event/state identity ambiguity (which concrete in-flight entity an event refers to)
entries.new_general_rule: event/state identity ambiguity is an algorithmic-semantics risk -> YELLOW
